Prepare a single PDF file containing the completed filled and signed application soft copy along with required qualification certificates, mark-sheets, research papers (if any), and work experience certificates.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment project at NIT Rourkela?
faq.answer: NIT Rourkela has invited applications for the Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) post under the project titled 'Exploiting allo- or xeno- geneic decellularized tissue matrix for developing an in vitro spermatogenesis system for restoration of male fertility' funded by ICMR.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NIT Rourkela Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application is 14-Oct-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degrees, or a Four Years Graduate Degree in Engineering / IT / CS.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, with age relaxations up to 5 years for SC, ST, PWD, and female applicants, and up to 3 years for OBC non-creamy layer candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly pay of Rs. 56,000.00.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for this post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must send a single PDF file containing the filled and signed application form and required documents via email with 'Advertisement No.' in the subject line to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. When and where is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 14-Oct-2026 at 10:00 AM at the Department of Biotechnology and Medical Engg., NIT Rourkela.
